fingerprint.goal: repair failing github actions pull request checks

rationale: Compared the candidate fingerprint with external capability openai:gh-fix-ci and internal github-release-evidence:audit-github-release. It is semantically the same CI-repair task as the registered official representative and has code-changing side effects unlike the read-only release audit. The deterministic catalog match supports discard: republishing or lightly rewriting the existing Skill would duplicate it, while merge and update are unavailable for an external artifact.
